verdict.rationale: Substantive text was quoted from INPI's public guidance pages (acces-au-guichet-unique, deposer-actes). That indirectly suggests the reading surface serves readable, non-JS-only content. However, no probe of inpi.fr records the HTTP status, user agent, or absence of a bot wall. The available probes cover other state hosts (annuaire-entreprises, recherche-entreprises), so they say nothing direct about INPI's pages. Missing for 10: a direct keyless probe of inpi.fr guidance pages with an identified user agent, its robots.txt stance, and confirmation of no Incapsula/CAPTCHA/JS-shell gating.
